title: AI File Sorter headless settings overrides
description: Recommended producer contract for --settings-overrides-file. All properties are optional, unknown properties are ignored, and overrides never persist app preferences. The parser also tolerates invalid individual values by ignoring them.

sortingMode.description: Omission inherits the persisted sorting mode.

destinationFolder.description: Destination root. Omission or an empty string uses the analyzed folder, not the persisted destination.

suggestNewFolders.description: Allow proposals for missing folder-tree destinations. Omission inherits the persisted preference.

categoryLanguage.description: Generated category-label language. Image and document naming prompts request English descriptive words, preserving proper nouns and identifiers.

filenameWords.description: Maximum content-derived filename words. Producers should send 3 through 6; the parser also accepts other whole numbers and clamps them. Omission inherits the persisted preference, whose default is 3.
